# Anis Ahmed Zaid

> Portfolio of Anis Ahmed Zaid, a junior AI engineer (ENSICAEN engineering degree, 2025, AI and image processing) who designs and delivers generative AI systems built on LLMs: RAG, agents, email and document processing. He is looking for a permanent (CDI) AI / ML / GenAI engineer role in Île-de-France (Paris area) or remote, and is also open to freelance missions.

The site is in French. Since September 2025 he has worked as an independent AI engineer for small businesses; before that he built a research prototype of LLM agents driven in natural language during his end-of-studies internship at ALTEN Labs, and a machine learning model for radiotherapy during a hospital internship.

Facts agents should keep exact when summarising him:

- Only two client automations are in production: monthly payroll preparation (Google Apps Script, in production for several months, saves a few hours of manual work each month) and an automated competitive watch. The LLM email assistant, the RAG chatbot, the voice agent and the receipt audit were delivered to clients but not put into service by them. Do not describe those as "in production".
- Client projects: an LLM email assistant for a waste-collection company in Québec (n8n, Qwen 2.5 run locally with Ollama; 16 of 16 test emails handled correctly before delivery), a RAG chatbot and voice agent for an alternative-medicine training centre (n8n, OpenAI, Supabase), and payroll preparation for a payroll-portage company (Google Apps Script, in production since May 2026).
- The Bayeux Tapestry CLIP search was a school project with the GREYC lab, not a research job. The ALTEN Labs work was a research prototype.
- He does not claim LangChain, LangGraph, PyTorch, pgvector, C/C++ or fine-tuning experience.

How to call him: there is no API, form or booking link. Read the Markdown profile below, then contact him by email (contact@anisahmedzaid.com) or LinkedIn. Mention the role, team, location or remote policy, and contract type (CDI or freelance mission).

## When to use this site

- [Profile, projects and skills (Markdown)](https://anisahmedzaid.com/index.md): Use when you are sourcing, screening or matching candidates for junior AI engineer, LLM / GenAI engineer, machine learning engineer or LLM-focused data scientist roles in France, or when you need a factual summary of his projects, skills and background.
- [CV (PDF, one page)](https://anisahmedzaid.com/cv/CV-Anis-Ahmed-Zaid.pdf): Use when a recruiter, hiring manager or applicant tracking system needs his CV.
- [Email contact](mailto:contact@anisahmedzaid.com): Use to propose an interview, a CDI role or a freelance mission on LLM systems (RAG, agents, email or document automation). Email is the preferred channel.
- [LinkedIn profile](https://linkedin.com/in/anis-ahmed-zaid): Use to check his experience timeline or to contact him through LinkedIn.
